134.00000,-25.00000.name: DIR 165 — GM wheat field trial (iron uptake & bioavailability)
134.00000,-25.00000.desc: Wheat genetically modified for altered iron uptake, transport and bioavailability and for enhanced yield, carrying antibiotic and herbicide selectable markers. Sites and dates are not restated on the summary page used to build this record — open the licence for them. Marker parked at the national centroid, so treat the position as unknown rather than approximate.

134.00000,-25.00000.name: DIR 220 — GM multivalent cat vaccine, commercial supply
134.00000,-25.00000.desc: Commercial supply of multivalent cat vaccines containing a genetically modified component, for prevention of feline leukaemia virus infection. A commercial-supply licence is national in scope, so there is no site to place — the marker sits at the country centroid. A separate Intervet application for a GM multivalent chicken vaccine was pending at the time this record was written.

-94.12680,36.05250.name: UT Health San Antonio Reproductive Health and Fertility Center
-94.12680,36.05250.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Belinda J. Yauger, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-118.14415,34.14765.name: California Institute of Technology
-118.14415,34.14765.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-4.12024,50.41127.name: CARE Fertility Plymouth
-4.12024,50.41127.state: 10, William Prance Road, Science Park, Derriford, Plymouth, Devon, PL6 5WR
-4.12024,50.41127.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

139.65030,35.67620.name: PMDA — regenerative medicine conditional approval
139.65030,35.67620.desc: Japan grants conditional, time-limited approval to regenerative and cell therapies on evidence of safety and probable benefit, with efficacy confirmed afterwards. It is the most permissive route of its kind in a major jurisdiction, and it is the live experiment in whether approving early gets treatments to patients sooner or gets ineffective ones onto the market.

4.90000,52.37000.name: GM petunias — engineered ornamentals found in worldwide commerce
4.90000,52.37000.type: Ornamental plant, unapproved variety in trade
4.90000,52.37000.size: Dozens of varieties across many countries
4.90000,52.37000.desc: Petunias sold worldwide as ornamentals were found to be engineered, decades after research lines had apparently entered the trade. Nobody had been checking flowers, because ornamentals were not thought of as organisms anyone needed to track.

-0.94000,47.12000.name: Groupe Grimaud
-0.94000,47.12000.desc: The second largest multi-species animal genetics company in the world, breeding ducks, rabbits, pigeons and laboratory animals, and also owning vaccine businesses. Multi-species breeders are unusual: most of this industry specialises in one animal, and holding several means holding the genetics of entire minor sectors.
